## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, fixes, or implements.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization / Refactoring
- [ ] Test suite addition

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests you performed to verify your changes. Include commands:
- [ ] Backend tests passing (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] TypeScript check passing (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Next.js production build succeeding (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Docker Compose verification (`docker compose up --build`)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `API.md`)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
